This is Canada! It goes all the way from one ocean to the other.
Canada's flag is red and white, with a red maple leaf in the middle.
People in Canada speak English and French. In Quebec, hello is Bonjour!
Canada is the second biggest country in the world.
Canada has long, snowy winters, and red and orange leaves in the fall.
The beaver is Canada's animal. Its teeth are orange and never stop growing.
Most of the world's maple syrup comes from Quebec.
Squirrels lick maple sap from the trees too!
The snowy owl is Quebec's bird.
Moose are the biggest deer in the world.
Raccoons wash their food with their little hands.
The loon's call sounds like laughing.
Grizzly bears sleep all winter in a den.
Sea otters hold hands so they don't float away.
The spirit bear is a black bear with white fur.
